lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਇ ਸਮਾਲੀ ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਥਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeei samaalee taa sabh dukh lathaa ||
lines.translation: When I dwell upon Him in my soul, all my sorrows depart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਿੰਤਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਈ ਹਉ ਪੀੜਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: chi(n)taa rog gaee hau peeRaa aap kare pratipaalaa jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: The sickness of anxiety and the disease of ego are cured; He Himself cherishes me. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਰਿਕ ਵਾਂਗੀ ਹਉ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੰਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: baarik vaa(n)gee hau sabh kichh ma(n)gaa ||
lines.translation: Like a child, I ask for everything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰੰਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: dede tot naahee prabh ra(n)gaa ||
lines.translation: God is Bountiful and Beautiful; He never comes up empty.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਨਾਈ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: pairee pai pai bahut manaaee deen daiaal gopaalaa jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: Again and again, I fall at His Feet. He is Merciful to the meek, the Sustainer of the World. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau balihaaree satigur poore ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to the Perfect True Guru,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin ba(n)dhan kaate sagale mere ||
lines.translation: who has shattered all my bonds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕੀਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਸਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੮॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: hiradai naam de niramal keee naanak ra(n)g rasaalaa jeeu ||4||8||15||
lines.translation: With the Naam, the Name of the Lord, in my heart, I have been purified. O Nanak, His Love has imbued me with nectar. ||4||8||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਲ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਰੰਗੀਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: laal gopaal daiaal ra(n)geele ||
lines.translation: O my Love, Sustainer of the World, Merciful, Loving Lord,

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gahir ga(n)bheer bea(n)t govi(n)de ||
lines.translation: Profoundly Deep, Infinite Lord of the Universe,

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਚ ਅਥਾਹ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ooch athaah bea(n)t suaamee simar simar hau jeevaa(n) jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: Highest of the High, Unfathomable, Infinite Lord and Master: continually remembering You in deep meditation, I live. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਅਮੋਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dukh bha(n)jan nidhaan amole ||
lines.translation: O Destroyer of pain, Priceless Treasure,

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰ ਅਥਾਹ ਅਤੋਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: nirabhau niravair athaah atole ||
lines.translation: Fearless, free of hate, Unfathomable, Immeasurable,

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੰਭੌ ਮਨ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਠੰਢਾ ਥੀਵਾਂ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: akaal moorat ajoonee sa(n)bhau man simarat tha(n)dhaa theevaa(n) jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: of Undying Form, Unborn, Self-illumined: remembering You in meditation, my mind is filled with a deep and profound peace. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa sa(n)gee har ra(n)g gopaalaa ||
lines.translation: The Joyous Lord, the Sustainer of the World, is my constant Companion.

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ooch neech kare pratipaalaa ||
lines.translation: He cherishes the high and the low.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਇਣੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਾਂ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naam rasaain man tripataain guramukh a(n)mrit peevaa(n) jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: The Nectar of the Name satisfies my mind. As Gurmukh, I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: dukh sukh piaare tudh dhiaaee ||
lines.translation: In suffering and in comfort, I meditate on You, O Beloved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: eh sumat guroo te paaee ||
lines.translation: I have obtained this sublime understanding from the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਧਰ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੀਵਾਂ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੯॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kee dhar too(n)hai thaakur har ra(n)g paar pareevaa(n) jeeu ||4||9||16||
lines.translation: You are Nanak's Support, O my Lord and Master; through Your Love, I swim across to the other side. ||4||9||16||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dha(n)n s velaa jit mai satigur miliaa ||
lines.translation: Blessed is that time when I meet the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਫਲੁ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਪੇਖਤ ਤਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: saphal darasan netr pekhat tariaa ||
lines.translation: Gazing upon the Fruitful Vision of His Darshan, I have been saved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਮੂਰਤ ਚਸੇ ਪਲ ਘੜੀਆ ਧੰਨਿ ਸੁ ਓਇ ਸੰਜੋਗਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: dha(n)n moorat chase pal ghaReeaa dha(n)n s oi sa(n)jogaa jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: Blessed are the hours, the minutes and the seconds-blessed is that Union with Him. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਤ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: udam karat man niramal hoaa ||
lines.translation: Making the effort, my mind has become pure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲਤ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਸਗਲਾ ਖੋਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har maarag chalat bhram sagalaa khoiaa ||
lines.translation: Walking on the Lord's Path, my doubts have all been cast out.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਸਗਲੇ ਰੋਗਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naam nidhaan satiguroo sunaaiaa mit gae sagale rogaa jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: The True Guru has inspired me to hear the Treasure of the Naam; all my illness has been dispelled. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar baahar teree baanee ||
lines.translation: The Word of Your Bani is inside and outside as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਥੀ ਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: tudh aap kathee tai aap vakhaanee ||
lines.translation: You Yourself chant it, and You Yourself speak it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੋ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਹੋਇਗਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: gur kahiaa sabh eko eko avar na koee hoigaa jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: The Guru has said that He is One-All is the One. There shall never be any other. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit ras har gur te peeaa ||
lines.translation: I drink in the Lord's Ambrosial Essence from the Guru;

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਥੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har painan naam bhojan theeaa ||
lines.translation: the Lord's Name has become my clothing and food.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਰੰਗ ਨਾਮਿ ਚੋਜ ਤਮਾਸੇ ਨਾਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀਨੇ ਭੋਗਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: naam ra(n)g naam choj tamaase naau naanak keene bhogaa jeeu ||4||10||17||
lines.translation: The Name is my delight, the Name is my play and entertainment. O Nanak, I have made the Name my enjoyment. ||4||10||17||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਸੰਤਨ ਪਹਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਇਕ ਮਾਂਗਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sagal sa(n)tan pahi vasat ik maa(n)gau ||
lines.translation: I beg of all the Saints: please, give me the merchandise.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਉ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਮਾਨੁ ਤਿਆਗਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: karau bina(n)tee maan tiaagau ||
lines.translation: I offer my prayers-I have forsaken my pride.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਰਿ ਵਾਰਿ ਜਾਈ ਲਖ ਵਰੀਆ ਦੇਹੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: vaar vaar jaaee lakh vareeaa dehu sa(n)tan kee dhooraa jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice, hundreds of thousands of times a sacrifice, and I pray: please, give me the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਦਾਤੇ ਤੁਮ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tum daate tum purakh bidhaate ||
lines.translation: You are the Giver, You are the Architect of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਸਮਰਥ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tum samarath sadaa sukhadaate ||
lines.translation: You are All-powerful, the Giver of Eternal Peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕੋ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਵਰਸਾਵੈ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sabh ko tum hee te varasaavai ausar karahu hamaaraa pooraa jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: You bless everyone. Please bring my life to fulfillment. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਭਵਨ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: darasan terai bhavan puneetaa ||
lines.translation: The body-temple is sanctified by the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan,

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਗੜੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਹੀ ਜੀਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aatam gaR bikham tinaa hee jeetaa ||
lines.translation: and thus, the impregnable fort of the soul is conquered.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਦਾਤੇ ਤੁਮ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਸੂਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: tum daate tum purakh bidhaate tudh jevad avar na sooraa jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: You are the Giver, You are the Architect of Destiny. There is no other warrior as great as You. ||3||
